english: A shiny red thing, stuck to the inner part of the top-wheel.
You approach the cog, and the sticky red thing stuck to it.
Grab the sticky red thing from the cogs without losing your fingers.
Ah. The dedendum. I see. It's the radial distance from the pitch circle down to the bottom land.
But the bottom land (also known as the tooth root by some lesser engineers) is the actual flat or curved surface at the very base of that valley.
You read about it in a book once. It was a very old guide to machinery, written before the Coast War.
Cool. This might come in handy.
Within a moment of focus, a splash of magical grease appears all over the cogs.
Within seconds, as it spreads throughout the system, the speed of it all ramps up.
Whole place is shaking. You really sped that shit up.
I'm not sure for what reason, but... I'm sure you have a plan here.
You swipe in a hand, and...
Hey, cool. It's a Stress Cube!
All the kids used to go crazy over these.
You know, the ones who called you Apple Boy.
Yeah. This isn't a great childhood memory for me.
What a nostalgic feeling. It's great for an adult like me to indulge in these childish toys.
A slice of a real gelatinous cube.
You could probably sell this for a quick buck next week.
Until then, eh, maybe give it a squeeze. Could help out with the nerves.
That doesn't seem to do anything.
The pain blinds you. But you feel it.
The goblin lets out an exasperated groan.
Meek must get good at spotting iron threat.
Meek assume: master is not going to put hand into grinding machine.
Yeah. Next time, don't fall down.
Come on. You gotta go try again, don't you?
